title: Studio-recorded voice datasets. Built to your brief.

sections.heading: Studio-recorded voice datasets. Built to your brief.
sections.body: Professional recordings to your specifications for speech technology. Native talent, supervised production and structured delivery, primarily in FIGS and Catalan.

sections.heading: FIGS + Catalan. Recorded on demand.
sections.body: French, Italian, German, Spain Spanish and Catalan. Talent profiles, availability and schedule are confirmed for each commission.

sections.heading: Control from script to file.
sections.body: For ASR, TTS, speech R&D teams and data providers that need consistent recordings. Each corpus is produced for its intended use; recognition and synthesis requirements are defined separately.

items.title: Custom studio recording
items.body: Client scripts and requirements recorded in a professional studio environment.

items.title: Talent sourcing
items.body: Selection and coordination of native speakers to the agreed profile.

items.title: Recording supervision
items.body: Direction and supervision for consistency across sessions.

items.title: Quality control
items.body: Technical and consistency checks before preparing delivery.

sections.heading: Your specification defines delivery.
sections.body: We agree the parameters before recording. There is no single format for every project.

items.title: Audio
items.body: Format, sample rate, bit depth, channels and separate tracks where required.

items.title: Recording conditions
items.body: Levels, background noise and consistency criteria.

items.title: Organization
items.body: Naming, script identifiers, folder structure and required metadata.

items.title: Usage and rights
items.body: Consent, voice rights and permitted uses expressly agreed for each project.

sections.heading: A new corpus. A defined process.

items.title: Define
items.body: Intended use, scripts, speaker profiles and requirements.

items.title: Review and deliver
items.body: QC and files organized to the agreed specification.

sections.heading: Tell us what voice data you need.
sections.body: Share the languages, speaker profiles, finished hours, intended use and requirements. We will confirm feasibility and scope before quoting.
